coverage.forms: All modal cases and operational/settings/research/workflow/notification forms traced to route payloads and error handling

findings.defect: Supervisor startup or shutdown failure skipped operational-worker cleanup
findings.repair: Move starts inside lifespan try and always stop the operational worker in nested finally

findings.defect: Raw JSON export could combine manual, autonomous, lab and research rows from different SQLite states
findings.repair: Read all raw sections in one read transaction and identify derived views as separately observed

findings.defect: A stale per-book policy form could overwrite a newer operator kill switch or policy
findings.repair: Pass the captured policy hash through PATCH/books into the existing domain transaction compare-and-swap; reject malformed envelopes
evidence: browser stale policy refusal and reopened form success

findings.defect: Operations badge stopped updating on non-autonomous views and treated running configuration as a live worker
findings.repair: Poll actual health continuously across views; distinguish paused, unavailable, degraded and active runtime in the topbar and overview/operations
evidence: browser Agent team runtime changes while remaining on the view

findings.defect: A new chart request immediately relabeled old symbol bars as the new symbol
findings.repair: Commit chart symbol with its successful bar response, and fence superseded/unmounted reads
evidence: browser AAPL fixture remains AAPL while delayed MSFT request is pending

findings.defect: An earlier research GET could overwrite refreshed collection evidence; service errors survived successful reads
findings.repair: Serialize/dedupe source reads, fence generations and unmount, force a post-collection read, and separate service-read errors from action errors
evidence: browser collection after delayed older source GET

findings.defect: Valid null push JSON caused an uncaught service-worker payload access
findings.repair: Normalize primitive/null/object payloads and notification title/body before display
evidence: service-worker VM checks for seven payload shapes

findings.defect: Browser subscription cleanup failures escaped as rejected promises after server disable, leaving stale local ownership
findings.repair: Clear ownership after confirmed server disable and catch/describe unsupported or failing browser cleanup
evidence: browser real disabled subscription plus injected browser cleanup failure; local storage cleared and zero active subscriptions

findings.defect: Client timeout messages suggested failed mutations although the server outcome was unknown; two historical fallback transports could exceed 15 seconds
findings.repair: Report mutation outcome as unconfirmed with refresh-before-retry guidance, and allow 45 seconds for bounded historical reads/continuation
evidence: HTTP client VM timeout and historical request budget checks

findings.defect: A position without a mark was labeled stale even though no mark existed
findings.repair: Show missing mark state distinctly before testing freshness

findings.defect: Broker cumulative receipts cannot prove complete realized execution chronology; UI/raw export did not state the resulting source coverage explicitly
findings.repair: Bind nullable broker accounting fields to visible coverage/reasons without substituting unknown values with zero; retain verified cash/equity and average-entry basis, add raw reconstruction-estimate and incomplete-fee notes to JSON export

findings.defect: Execution table read fill.fees instead of the public fill.fee, hiding measured local fees
findings.repair: Read the singular public fee field; preserve explicit unverified complete broker fee scope
evidence: Local receipt singular fee fixture displays $0.25

findings.defect: Execution table read timestamp/created_at while receipt contract exposes observed_at, displaying Not yet for measured receipts
findings.repair: Display receipt observed_at and separate full source_timestamp evidence; do not imply cumulative source receipts constitute ordered execution activities
evidence: Broker/local fixture observation cells contain the actual supplied observation date

validation.production_build: npm run typecheck and npm run build passed; index-CHhv1Bb5.js / index-Sdmf3nfc.css

limits: Default desk database was not changed by audit interactions. QA used isolated manual-feed DB, worker disabled; market/source and missing-mark UI receipts are explicitly identified fixtures.
No actual broker order, external notification delivery or public push subscription was attempted. An inert push.audit.invalid subscription was disabled through the real local API to exercise cleanup.
Optional live broker/model/external delivery integrations were not end-to-end connected by this frontend audit.
Generated distribution bundles and font/dependency bodies are build outputs/vendor code, not independently reviewed first-party implementations.
Atomic raw JSON evidence does not make derived provider/account/report views simultaneous; export explicitly identifies their scope.

Broker accounting browser follow-up uses explicit response fixtures for unknown basis, known source basis and local receipt fields; HTTP coverage separately exercises measured cumulative fills through a simulated broker object.
